provenance.limits: All nine supplied restored-topics captures were inspected for the original palette, stronger type, photo-overlay hero, restored choices, and guided menus. Parent evidence reports 62 automated tests and browser journeys passing; menu-checks.json records seven non-waste menus without overflow and detector.json has zero primary findings. reports/TOPIC-RESTORATION-HANDOFF.md confirms the parent’s final TypeScript/Vite build passed with index-CaOemWGg.js and index-BHzalREE.css; runtime/test hashes match the frozen snapshot at .reports/topic-restoration-2026-10-26. This pass did not rerun the tests or build. Deployment is held during release coordination. Specimens are structurally checked, not separately browser-rendered.

extensions.tonalRampPolicy: Synthesised inspection aids; exact source colours in DESIGN.md remain normative.

recordPresentation.policy: Preserve originals; sanitize displayed record phone fields, recognised number-bearing prose, and phone/WhatsApp actions. Use source organisation descriptions and an explicit missing-bio fallback.
recordPresentation.scope: Presentation only; original catalogue data is still retained.

articleImages.gallery: Two columns, 24px gap, natural-height images; one column at 620px.

hero.autoplay: Requires enabled playback, visible document, hero intersection through a 25%-threshold observer, no control hover, and a loaded next photo. Interactive focus (except rotation control), manual navigation, and touch swipe pause persistently. Programmatic heading focus does not pause. Reduced motion disables autoplay, movement, and transitions, hides Play, and preserves manual navigation. Failed images are excluded.
hero.responsive: Photo fills the shell and becomes viewport-wide at 620px. Content padding is 18px 24px 62px on desktop, 14px 20px 72px on phones, with the short-phone rule at 18px top and 66px bottom. The emergency action shares the topic-heading row, then becomes full-width on phones. Eight bordered topic choices follow in four columns, two at 850px, at minimum 82px height. Captions remain over the bottom scrim.

topicNavigation.restoration: Earlier guided topic menus restored; no new concept seed. Original paper/green palette and neutral choice border retained.
topicNavigation.home: Four columns with 8px gaps; two at 850px. Minimum height 82px; padding 12px, 10px on phones. Icons 26px, hidden at 620px; arrows hidden at 1150px.
topicNavigation.guided: Three columns, two for two/four choices; two at 850px and one at 620px. Minimum height 120px and padding 24px; 100px and 20px on phones. Icons 40px. Breadcrumbs and explicit back links preserve the route hierarchy.
topicNavigation.states: Neutral 1px full border, paper resting surface, pale hover with green border, line-colour active fill, shared keyboard outline, 120ms transitions removed for reduced motion.

evidence.build: Parent handoff confirms TypeScript/Vite production build passed: index-CaOemWGg.js and index-BHzalREE.css.

narrative.overview:
ActForGoa is an open, calm field guide. Warm paper carries green ink, large upright headings, useful local information, and real photographs. The page earns its structure through typography, generous space, and horizontal rules.

The approved refinement keeps the original warm-paper and green palette, with stronger upright typography. Topic browsing, reading, and contact actions share one continuous page ground. On the homepage, the heading and question composer sit over real local photography. Official Arc components provide consistent controls and interaction behavior, with the project’s colours, type, and modest corner radius applied through the foundation tokens.
keyCharacteristics: Continuous warm paper and forest-green text.
Strong upright Manrope throughout, including mission, article, and feed headings.
Bordered topic choices with strong labels and helpful descriptions; open resource rows.
Real local photographs with square crops.
Shared Arc control behavior with fill-based text-field focus.

rules.name: The Upright Type Rule
rules.body: Use upright text throughout, including the wordmark, quotations, labels, and numerals. Emphasis comes from size, weight, and space.

rules.name: The Open Page Rule
rules.body: Keep the introduction, editorial pairings, records, and source context on the page ground. Use spacing and structural rules instead of enclosing them in panels.

rules.name: The Structural Line Rule
rules.body: Horizontal rules may separate records or sections; existing control borders may define inputs. Never add decorative side stripes to content containers.

rules.name: The Stable Focus Rule
rules.body: Text-entry focus changes the fill and caret without adding a new border, visible ring, or size change. Links and buttons retain the shared Arc keyboard outline.

rules.name: The Source Proximity Rule
rules.body: Keep historical dates, original-source links, and contact caveats close to the records they qualify. A prepared email is not a sent message.

rules.name: The Browsing Continuity Rule
rules.body: Preserve scroll position when filtering or resubmitting a query on search. Returning to a catalogue history entry restores its expanded results and chosen layout.

dos: Do preserve the open paper ground, green ink, and real local photographs.
Do use Manrope throughout and the installed Arc components, including SiteHeader, with project overrides.
Do preserve the feed’s automatic, paused, manual, and restored states.
Do keep the stronger type hierarchy, readable record titles, and text fields at 16px.
Do keep text-entry focus stable and preserve shared keyboard focus on actions.
Do preserve browsing position, expanded results, and the selected layout through history navigation.
Do keep source context and contact caveats visible, while keeping phone data out of record presentation.
donts: Don't restore the boxed green introduction, filled record cards, or pale story panel.
Don't reintroduce the withdrawn brown, pink, and yellow palette, colourful filled topic tiles, a dark header, yellow search buttons, or ochre focus outlines.
Don't add a new focus border, visible ring, or layout shift to text fields.
Don't use serif, italic, or oblique type anywhere.
Don't add decorative side stripes, eyebrow labels, or fabricated local imagery.
Don't invent organisation biographies or replace missing original photographs with fabricated images.
Don't imply current contact verification or successful message delivery without evidence.
